Fatih Birol: The Energy World Will Never Be the Same As Before the Iran War

For more than a decade, Fatih Birol has been one of the world’s most influential voices in energy markets. As the head of the International Energy Agency (IEA), he advises presidents and energy ministers; CEOs follow his view of the market with careful attention. When we caught up at the United Nations climate change conference, known as COP31 , currently underway in Antalya, Turkey, he offered a blunt analysis: the war in Iran has unleashed a structural shift.
